anyOf.title: Regex
anyOf.description: A regex string, to be used with `MATCHES` or `DOES_NOT_MATCH`

anyOf.title: Number
anyOf.description: A number, to be used with `IS_GREATER_THAN`, `IS_GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO`, `IS_LESS_THAN`, `IS_LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO`, `IS_EQUAL_TO`, or `IS_NOT_EQUAL_TO`

anyOf.title: List of Strings
anyOf.description: An array of strings, to be used with `IS_ONE_OF` or `IS_NOT_ONE_OF`

anyOf.title: Timestamp
anyOf.description: A timestamp, to be used with `IS_AFTER` or `IS_BEFORE`
